definitions.gloss: however; but then; contrary to expectations
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce an unexpected result or development that contrasts with what was anticipated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。ところが、⟦{晴|は}れた→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧。
examples.english: I thought it would rain. But then it cleared up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧。ところが、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: I thought it would be easy. However, it was very difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。ところが、⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: He wasn't supposed to come. But then he suddenly appeared.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。ところが、⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: I thought she was angry. But then she welcomed me with a smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。ところが、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{遅|おく}れていた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ので⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I thought the train delay would make me late for our appointment. But then the other person was also late, so it was fine.

notes:
ところが introduces an outcome that is contrary to expectations.

USAGE:
- The first part sets up an expectation
- ところが introduces what actually happened (unexpected)
- Implies surprise or contrast with assumptions

DIFFERENCE FROM OTHER CONJUNCTIONS:
- ところが: emphasizes unexpected contrast
- しかし: general contrast, neutral
- でも/だけど: simple contrast, no surprise implied
- けれども: general adversative, can end sentences

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜と{思|おも}った。ところが... (I thought ~. But then...)
- 〜はずだった。ところが... (It was supposed to be ~. However...)

Note: ところが always connects to the following clause; it cannot end a sentence.
